label: Grounded entry into the perfection-transfer cycle; nonuniversal transfer isolated as the leaf
summary: Cycle map (#1476, PR #1480): unrestricted transfer f8ba2429 had one non-transcription proof, CAUSAL-PERFECTION-TRANSFER-RECONSTRUCTION (fc46c3ea), from universal-scope transfer b26c10a0 and the residual 5a4afaa5 (case split on decided universality and identity). The residual had one, CAUSAL-PERFECTION-TRANSFER-DELTA-FORWARD (3952799d), a projection of f8ba2429. Both directions are genuine, but the residual is by construction the scope delta of f8ba2429 over b26c10a0, so the cycle had no entry. b26c10a0 itself is grounded (from total causation, dae70d8a); its projection from f8ba2429 is a transcription. Grounded entry: the residual's two conjuncts were separated. Its self-effect conjunct is vacuous under the existing open premise STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-BEING (b62a64ab), already on root routes. Its nonuniversal conjunct has no derivation from premises outside the cycle unless a premise at least as strong on the nonuniversal cases is added. The candidate found, that only a universal cause causes anything's esse (which would make the conjunct vacuous), is stronger, unregistered and unresolved. Lead for it: I q.45 a.5 (only God produces esse absolutely), unread. Bearing against it: I q.104 a.1 co. (passage AQUINAS-ST-I-Q104-A1-EN, read for this attempt) says that agents not producing an effect of their own species, 'thus the heavenly bodies cause the generation of inferior bodies which differ from them in species', can cause 'a form as such' and so are 'not merely the cause of becoming but also the cause of being'. That reaches CausesIn c x esse only through the open bridge of DISAMB-BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE (c3c01e92), and no claim on file records the sentence (the q.104 claims cover becoming versus being and conservation). The sun and air passage of the same article concerns the being of light in the air, an accidental perfection, and serves as an analogy for God and creatures. It is not counted against the stronger thesis. The nonuniversal conjunct is registered as its own open premise, NonuniversalPerfectionTransfer (10cd24ed). f8ba2429 is derived from excluded middle, b26c10a0, 10cd24ed and b62a64ab (result a3d5fb1a: x is not c by no self-causation of esse, then a case split on universality). f8ba2429 and 5a4afaa5 now close as proved from open premises, and 10cd24ed is the new bare leaf. Controls (40f6a49b): each nonlogical premise is needed in an explicit interpretation (part 1 reuses the concurrent background model 66aab41c); 10cd24ed is strictly weaker than the residual; all premises hold nonvacuously with an actual nonuniversal esse edge. Unregistered companion lemmas nonuniversalOfResidual and residualIffNonuniversal (given b62a64ab) check the remaining relations. WARNING: do not register 5a4afaa5 => 10cd24ed, as an argument or a strengthens relation; it would recreate an ungrounded support cycle under the #1480 rule. Better-motivated leaf: neither cycle member should stand as the leaf. The q.4 a.2 and q.6 a.2 support claims on f8ba2429 concern God as first cause or as subsistent being, which is b26c10a0's scope. The residual had no warrant of its own. 10cd24ed is strictly weaker than the residual and carries exactly the content with no warrant on file. Objection audit (substantive objection standard, both ways): against 10cd24ed, no substantive objection is established. Its rival (a particular cause of esse that does not cause a perfection another agent causes) is model-witnessed only (control part 1). Leads, unweighted: (a) target 10cd24ed; mechanism: if the q.104 a.1 heavenly bodies are nonuniversal causes of the being of what they generate, 10cd24ed applies to them non-vacuously and would require that they cause every perfection of those effects, intellectual ones included. Missing: the c3c01e92 bridge to CausesIn esse, and a read of I q.115 a.4 (whether heavenly bodies act on intellect), unread. (b) The 'continuous supply sustaining an organism' example in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md motivates the rival, but as stated it is enablement, a necessary condition, not CausesIn at esse. It fails the standard's mechanism requirement and carries no weight unless a supply is shown to cause the being in sense 3. There is also no positive warrant on file. The strongest positive case on file for transfer (participation plus concurrence, q.105 a.5) rests on the source being the universal first agent that applies every agent to its operation, and a nonuniversal cause by definition lacks that universal scope. That is the specific difference that keeps the argument for b26c10a0 from extending to 10cd24ed; it is an absence of warrant, not evidence against the premise. Against b62a64ab, no objection on file; causa sui (Descartes, Fourth Replies) is an unread lead with no weight. Excluded middle is the existing self-evident premise with a met floor basis. No premise is established.
blocker: 10cd24ed (nonuniversal transfer) has no derivation and no warrant on file. Next tests: (1) 43 arguments take f8ba2429 as a premise; two belong to the cycle itself (delta-forward 0bb5f653 and the transcription 992770d3), so 41 are candidates for re-routing to b26c10a0 where universal scope suffices, as docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md already did for naming, reduced description and goodness. Record which ones need unrestricted transfer; the likely case is perfection preexistence from causal transfer (6b609ddc), which quantifies over every cause of esse. (2) Read I q.45 a.5 (for only-universal causation of esse) and I q.115 a.4 (lead a), and decide the c3c01e92 bridge for the q.104 a.1 heavenly-body sentence. (3) Instrumental-causation bridge: a particular cause of esse acts as an instrument of the universal cause. This bears on preexistence rather than on 10cd24ed; source lead De potentia q.3 a.7, unread.
